esim-plan-picker/bd-j0h87kkb.note: Frutiger Aero gloss is a plausible telecom mood and the Arabic type is handled, but the twist undercuts itself: a white hero with ink on light pairs ignores the white-text-on-color constraint, the sign-sheeting dot screen clashes with aero gloss, and the single glossy button never touches comparing GB and days.

esim-plan-picker/bd-h72qsjp3.note: Bars suit comparing GB and days, but the idea lands on section dividers instead of the plans, the Ring Sizer twist has no clear link to the title, and a ticked gray track is closer to a styling rule than a fresh idea.

esim-plan-picker/bd-39rqqcaf.note: Numbered manual steps suit picking and installing an eSIM and a giant number can carry GB or price, but the twist title is cut off, the lit-board grain fights the printed-page mood, and the only mechanic is a plain numbered header bar that leaves the flat-pack idea unused.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-ou6hyjg3.note: Curved plank steps with a brass nail on the current one give the review, bags and seats, and pay flow a real progress mechanic rooted in a Gulf craft, and the teak and brass palette and seam texture hold together, though the boat-for-a-flight link in whyItFits is thin.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-hrbktbfa.note: The survey paper palette and contour lines tightening around the total hang together and keep the clear total. The map link to a GCC flight checkout is thin, and the header bar with one thin line is a modest twist.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-gwuh8nk1.note: The palette, the balcony-edge divider and the Arabic type hang together, but Beirut 1960s modernism is a Levantine tradition rather than a Gulf one, which caps relevance for a GCC brief, and a styled divider line is a modest hook.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-vcnkeh1c.note: Scandinavian modern suits a coffee landing page, but the twist is truncated, the one-type-size constraint clashes with a 48 to 120px display and 18px body, the flat signal-blue texture contradicts both the teak-grain card and the palette, and whyItFits talks about notes and tasks.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-bc3ab8qb.note: Hairline rules could suit a coffee menu, but nothing here is coffee-specific, the summary table the texture sits behind does not exist on a landing page, and the Bookmarks twist never shows up in the mechanic, leaving a boxed text button that reads as a style rule rather than an idea.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-7lorzk9m.note: Numbered manual anchors suit a sectioned coffee landing page, but the sun-faded oldest card is loosely tied to the manual idea and the signature misses the obvious hook of line-drawn brewing steps.

banking-onboarding/bd-e4t6j7q6.note: A single accent color is a rule with no idea, the forest floor mood never shows up in the palette, and section tabs are a weak fit for a stepped onboarding that must keep clear progress.

banking-onboarding/bd-qj9bo2f9.note: Termeh bands on a global banking onboarding assume a craft most users do not know and ignore the must-keep clear progress, though the restrained white, red and neo-grotesk pieces hold together as a safe, buildable but unremarkable decorative divider.

banking-onboarding/bd-omq0u3au.note: Onboarding has steps rather than a total, so framing a total misses the page and ignores the clear progress it must keep, and the rain-soaked mood never connects to the vague giant grid squares.

fitness-empty-state/bd-mf9pdvoe.note: Dala painting has no tie to fitness or to users worldwide. A long scroll does not suit a mostly empty screen. The toxic green mood clashes with the red and blue flowers, and the pointing hands and the scroll rule never connect to the dala framing.

fitness-empty-state/bd-gr51j7la.note: A hip hop flyer empty state could give a fitness app real voice. But the bureaucratic mood and flat-pack manual go unused, and the soft corduroy and cool, restrained contrast pull against the crisp, loud photocopy look.

fitness-empty-state/bd-46y3xf7w.note: An empty state does have a main button to skin, but faded dried leaves suggest decay rather than a fitness start, postmodern 1985 brights pull against soft forest floor browns, and a textured button with a grotesk label is a thin idea for wildness 5.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-rexi5dm9.note: The folder and 1980s manual pair well as office paper and the hero is buildable, but nothing ties a Western filing folder to Ramadan, Saudi food or offers, and the 'notebooks and tasks' rationale belongs to another brief.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-nv3wopu5.note: The folding paper plane button is a neat, buildable touch, but office paper, ruled notes and a compose card have nothing to do with Ramadan, food offers or a Gulf market, and the pale soft palette with 6 percent crease shading works against the hard flat look of Neo-Brutalism.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-mlflcvve.note: The amber mica flake button is a specific, buildable idea, but nothing in it speaks to Ramadan or iftar. Scandinavian 1955 teak and linen is another region's tradition on a GCC brief. Mineral mica, Nordic wood and techy mono type pull apart, and the fit note about stacked pages does not match the direction.

saas-pricing/bd-5f2rzk1m.note: Plans as manila cards with a typed price and a red stamp for the offer date fit a pricing page and keep the price clear, and the palette, mono type and stamp texture all serve the time stamp idea, though the layout and whyItFits lines are thin.

saas-pricing/bd-6bszax32.note: A marbled top strip marking the best value plan fits a pricing page and keeps the price clear, and the cream paper, serif type and ink palette belong together, but the idea is a modest accent and the texture note about a collection cover card is leftover from another page.

saas-pricing/bd-omdsleqr.note: Treating plans as parts lists could work on a pricing page, but a line drawing of a software product is vague and the tick-off steps rationale points to steps this page does not have.

dubai-real-estate/bd-iga15poh.note: A square Kufic word built from tiles is a fresh, buildable header, but the turquoise and brick mosque tilework reads Persian rather than Dubai luxury, and a user-chosen word has no clear job on a listing page.

dubai-real-estate/bd-ej4ir7we.note: Hejazi coral stone and roshan timber are a fitting Gulf tradition for a property page, though less natural for modern Dubai towers. The graph paper twist only shows up loosely as tick marks and course lines, and the timber divider band is tidy but modest rather than a stop-scrolling idea.

dubai-real-estate/bd-nci0pe0q.note: Farm pivot circles and 1930s Ankara letterpress do not fit Dubai luxury apartments on a GCC brief, the texture sits on step cards a listing page does not have, and the sand bar with a green circle logo is a plain header rather than an idea.

kids-reading-home/bd-4i9yco1g.note: A rain-dark cyberpunk skin is a stretch for a kids reading home screen, the wax seals clash with the 1982 neon era, and the twist is just a no-rounded-corners rule with no idea behind it.

kids-reading-home/bd-044ehsdf.note: A circus poster header with corduroy texture suits a playful kids reading home screen, but the Ankara palette competes with the circus poster colors, and the idea stops at a header strip and a vaguely described poster card.

kids-reading-home/bd-9ug5mj3y.note: Porcelain bands can split the stacked shelves of a kids reading home, but the giant paper clips never get a job in the layout or signature and pull against the porcelain look, so the idea stays vague.

qatar-gov-services/bd-sls3szfr.note: Twinwall ribs as a frosted grid suit a calm, bilingual government dashboard at low wildness and hang together well, but the idea only touches the empty state, leaves clear status unaddressed, and stays fairly modest.

qatar-gov-services/bd-98yb5qmi.note: A segmented status track suits ID renewals and fine payments and keeps status clear at low wildness, though brine pink as the completed state could read like an error and the cosmic mood does not fit the salt ponds or the page.

qatar-gov-services/bd-n1ydqtzg.note: A fines balance in steady tabular figures fits a calm Qatar services dashboard with Arabic RTL, but the idea is a typesetting rule rather than a design idea, and it never addresses the clear status the brief must keep.
